comments.body:
Discovery Name: "Helepolis"
Discovery Description: "A large seige tower, 40 meters tall and 20 meters wide, sent by Demetrius I of Macedon during the Siege of Rhodes in an attempt to capture Rhodes. It is believed to have consisted of mutiple floors which were equipped with various arnaments."

Quest Name: Giant Siege Tower
Skills Required: R6 Search, R8 Archaeology, Greek

Quest Details: Just what in the world was the siege tower that Demetrius sent to Rhodes during the 'Siege of Rhodes'? For anecdotes regarding one of the Seven Wonders of the world, perhaps you may be able to investigate about them in detail at the Archives in Athens.

Quest obtained with 8-star clue from new Treasure Hunt Legend Regarding an Old Map
